Open the [label prototype](http://maker:4001/index.html?flow=labels). On the **CSS Grid** card, select **Add label**, enter `Design`, add it, then select the new **Design** label. Tell me whether adding and using a label this way feels natural.

I’ve assumed labels appear as visible chips on each card, are added directly on that card, and selecting a chip narrows the whole library to bookmarks carrying it.
